title: Failed Restore Repeat Offenders
dataSources: Breach alerts (`hibp:alert`), password age snapshots (`passwordage:account`), backup restore tests (`backuprestore:test`), and DNS leak checks (`dnsleak:check`).
app: Personal security telemetry from Have I Been Pwned, password-age exports, backup restore drills, and DNS leak checks sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=backuprestore:test
| stats count(eval(status!="success")) as failed_restores count as tests by backup_set
| sort 0 - failed_restores
description: Ranks backup setss by failed restore repetitions.
value: Repeat offenders show where to spend backup engineering time first instead of chasing isolated failures.
implementation: Send failed restore repetitions events to `index=personal` and keep `backup_set` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of failed restore repetitions by backup sets.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which backup setss stand out most for failed restore repetitions.
